### The White Horse
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-white-horse-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-12.html
Passage: Revelation 19:11, 13, 16
Points:
- Worldly rulers are fallible, but the rider on the white horse embodies absolute reliability, truth, and supreme authority.
- The mysterious warrior is Jesus Christ, the eternal Word of God, returning in power to execute righteous judgment.
- Christ's blood-stained garment provides a sobering reminder that the final Judge came first as the suffering Savior.
- Judgment is reserved for those who reject His grace, while the warrior-king warmly receives anyone who humbly repents.

### One of These Things Is Not Like the Other Ones: A Devotion on Good Friday and Easter
Author: Lisa Harper
Site: Bible Gateway
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/learn/voices/king-of-kings-easter-devotional/
Passage: Revelation 19:11-16
Points:
- Describing Jesus as King of kings sets Him entirely apart from every earthly ruler in human history.
- The disciples often misunderstood Christ's reign by expecting a worldly, self-serving political hierarchy.
- A Roman centurion recognized Jesus' true divinity not from royal pageantry, but from witnessing His sacrificial death.
- Christianity uniquely centers on a supreme King who voluntarily laid down His life and suffered to redeem His people.
